texts: Every lantern has a glass dome.
Every lantern has an iron reservoir for mire-essence.

fields.sentence: Every lantern has a glass dome.

review.notes: Explicit universal with a dependent existential correctly uses the Skolem-function dome, Holder/Theme for 'has', and the QuantifierPhrase companion; glass_dome emits only its head genus, correctly withholding the noun modifier 'glass' per the part-of-speech test.

fields.sentence: Every lantern has an iron reservoir for mire-essence.

review.notes: An explicit universal with an indefinite singular object correctly stays an event rule rather than a kind relation (the 'lions have manes' trigger needs bare kinds on both sides); Holder/Theme for 'have', per-lantern Skolem reservoir, genus-only decomposition for the noun modifiers 'iron' and 'mire', and the noun-attached (For ...) purpose oblique are all licensed.
